details: The US Consumer Price Index (CPI) rose 3.8% year-over-year in April 2026, marking the fastest pace since 2023. Energy prices were a significant contributor, surging 17.9% over the past year and 3.8% in April alone, with gasoline prices up 28.4%. The Cleveland Fed projects May CPI to climb even higher to 4.2%. This persistent inflation, exacerbated by the ongoing US-Iran conflict, could prompt the Federal Reserve to maintain elevated interest rates or even consider hikes, making traditional assets more attractive.
sourceName: Bureau of Labor Statistics / The Guardian
title: US Inflation Surges to 3.8% in April, May Forecast Higher

details: Several European Central Bank (ECB) Governing Council members have indicated a potential interest rate hike at the ECB's June 2026 meeting. This move is being considered due to persistent inflation risks, particularly those stemming from rising oil prices and geopolitical uncertainties. While some officials suggest a one-time adjustment, others emphasize that an interest rate move will be unavoidable if the inflationary outlook does not significantly improve. Analysts from a Bloomberg survey also predict two 25-basis-point hikes this year, in June and September.
title: ECB Officials Signal Potential June Rate Hike Amid Inflation Risks

details: The ongoing US-Iran conflict remains a major geopolitical risk, contributing to a renewed oil shock and driving up energy prices globally. The International Energy Agency (IEA) reported an "unprecedented" oil supply shock, with crude supply losses depleting global inventories at a record pace due to sustained restrictions in the Strait of Hormuz. This situation reinforces sticky inflation and limits central banks' room to cut interest rates, increasing pressure on risk assets, including cryptocurrencies.
title: US-Iran Conflict Escalates, Threatening Global Oil Supply and Driving Inflation

details: The US Senate Banking Committee has advanced the landmark "Digital Asset Market Clarity Act" to the full Senate for a vote. This legislation aims to establish clearer regulatory guidelines for cryptocurrencies, a development that is seen as a significant positive for the industry. News of the bill's progress led to an uptick in crypto stocks, including Coinbase. However, the bill is expected to face a fierce lobbying fight.
title: US Senate Banking Committee Advances Crypto Clarity Act

details: Kevin Warsh has been confirmed by the US Senate as the new Federal Reserve Chair. This leadership transition at the central bank introduces a new layer of uncertainty regarding future monetary policy and liquidity management. While Warsh has previously indicated a preference for lower interest rates, persistently high inflation could make it challenging for him to advocate for rate cuts immediately.
title: Kevin Warsh Confirmed as New Federal Reserve Chair

details: President Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping held a summit in Beijing (May 13-15, 2026), with discussions focusing on the implications of the Middle East conflict (Iran and Strait of Hormuz) and efforts to ease trade tensions. Initial reports indicated positive discussions, with both leaders acknowledging common interests outweighing differences, particularly regarding the need to reopen the Strait of Hormuz. The outcome of these high-stakes negotiations could influence global financial market stability.
title: US-China Summit Addresses Trade and Geopolitical Tensions
